    +-------------+---------------------------+------+-------------+
    | (0028,0100) | BitsAllocated             | 1    | Required    |
    +-------------+---------------------------+------+-------------+

    Parameters
    ----------
    ds : Dataset
        The :class:`~pydicom.dataset.Dataset` containing the Image Pixel module
        and *Pixel Data*.
    unit : str, optional
        If ``'bytes'`` then returns the expected length of the *Pixel Data* in
        whole bytes and NOT including an odd length trailing NULL padding
        byte. If ``'pixels'`` then returns the expected length of the *Pixel
        Data* in terms of the total number of pixels (default ``'bytes'``).

    Returns
    -------
    int
        The expected length of the *Pixel Data* in either whole bytes or
        pixels, excluding the NULL trailing padding byte for odd length data.
    """
    rows = cast(int, ds.Rows)
    columns = cast(int, ds.Columns)
    samples_per_pixel = cast(int, ds.SamplesPerPixel)
    bits_allocated = cast(int, ds.BitsAllocated)

    length = rows * columns * samples_per_pixel
    length *= get_nr_frames(ds)

    if unit == "pixels":
        return length

    # Correct for the number of bytes per pixel
    if bits_allocated == 1:
        # Determine the nearest whole number of bytes needed to contain
        #   1-bit pixel data. e.g. 10 x 10 1-bit pixels is 100 bits, which
        #   are packed into 12.5 -> 13 bytes
        length = length // 8 + (length % 8 > 0)
    else:
        length *= bits_allocated // 8

    # DICOM Standard, Part 4, Annex C.7.6.3.1.2
    if ds.PhotometricInterpretation == "YBR_FULL_422":
        length = length // 3 * 2

    return length

"""Tests for enhanced multi-frame frame operations."""

import pytest

from pydicom import (
    Dataset,
    FileMetaDataset,
    MultiFrameError,
    extract_frames,
    frame_attributes,
    group_frames,
    merge_frames,
    sort_frames,
    varying_attributes,
)
from pydicom.encaps import encapsulate, generate_frames
from pydicom.sequence import Sequence
from pydicom.tag import Tag
from pydicom.uid import ExplicitVRLittleEndian, JPEGBaseline8Bit, generate_uid


def make_dataset(
    number_of_frames: int = 4, *, encapsulated: bool = False
) -> Dataset:
    ds = Dataset()
    ds.file_meta = FileMetaDataset()
    ds.file_meta.TransferSyntaxUID = (
        JPEGBaseline8Bit if encapsulated else ExplicitVRLittleEndian
    )
    ds.SOPClassUID = "1.2.3"
    ds.SOPInstanceUID = generate_uid()
    ds.NumberOfFrames = number_of_frames
    ds.Rows = 1
    ds.Columns = 2
    ds.SamplesPerPixel = 1
    ds.PhotometricInterpretation = "MONOCHROME2"
    ds.BitsAllocated = 8
    ds.BitsStored = 8
    ds.HighBit = 7
    ds.PixelRepresentation = 0

    shared_item = Dataset()
    shared_macro = Dataset()
    shared_macro.SliceThickness = 1
    shared_item.PixelMeasuresSequence = Sequence([shared_macro])
    ds.SharedFunctionalGroupsSequence = Sequence([shared_item])

    frame_items = []
    for index in range(number_of_frames):
        frame_item = Dataset()
        position = Dataset()
        position.ImagePositionPatient = [0, 0, index]
        frame_item.PlanePositionSequence = Sequence([position])
        frame_content = Dataset()
        frame_content.StackID = "A" if index < 2 else "B"
        frame_content.InStackPositionNumber = index + 1
        frame_item.FrameContentSequence = Sequence([frame_content])
        frame_items.append(frame_item)
    ds.PerFrameFunctionalGroupsSequence = Sequence(frame_items)

    frames = [bytes([index, index + 1]) for index in range(number_of_frames)]
    ds.PixelData = encapsulate(frames) if encapsulated else b"".join(frames)
    return ds


def test_frame_attributes_and_varying_attributes_are_effective_copies():
    ds = make_dataset()

    attrs = frame_attributes(ds, 0)
    assert attrs.SliceThickness == 1
    assert attrs.ImagePositionPatient == [0, 0, 0]
    assert Tag("ImagePositionPatient") in attrs
    assert Tag("ImagePositionPatient") in varying_attributes(ds)

    attrs.SliceThickness = 2
    assert ds.SharedFunctionalGroupsSequence[0].PixelMeasuresSequence[0].SliceThickness == 1
    assert Tag("SliceThickness") not in varying_attributes(ds)


def test_extract_reorders_and_normalizes_derived_instance():
    ds = make_dataset()
    out = extract_frames(ds, [3, 1])

    assert out.NumberOfFrames == 2
    assert out.PixelData == b"\x03\x04\x01\x02"
    assert out.SOPInstanceUID != ds.SOPInstanceUID
    assert out.file_meta.MediaStorageSOPInstanceUID == out.SOPInstanceUID
    assert out.SourceImageSequence[0].ReferencedFrameNumber == [4, 2]
    assert [
        item.FrameContentSequence[0].InStackPositionNumber
        for item in out.PerFrameFunctionalGroupsSequence
    ] == [1, 1]
    assert ds.PixelData == b"\x00\x01\x01\x02\x02\x03\x03\x04"


def test_merge_group_and_sort():
    first = make_dataset(2)
    second = make_dataset(2)
    second.SOPClassUID = first.SOPClassUID
    second.Rows = first.Rows
    second.Columns = first.Columns
    second.SamplesPerPixel = first.SamplesPerPixel
    second.PhotometricInterpretation = first.PhotometricInterpretation
    second.BitsAllocated = first.BitsAllocated
    second.BitsStored = first.BitsStored
    second.HighBit = first.HighBit
    second.PixelRepresentation = first.PixelRepresentation

    merged = merge_frames([first, second])
    assert merged.NumberOfFrames == 4
    assert len(merged.SourceImageSequence) == 2
    assert merged.SourceImageSequence[0].ReferencedFrameNumber == [1, 2]
    assert merged.SourceImageSequence[1].ReferencedFrameNumber == [1, 2]

    groups = group_frames(make_dataset(), "StackID")
    assert [group.NumberOfFrames for group in groups] == [2, 2]
    sorted_ds = sort_frames(make_dataset(), "ImagePositionPatient")
    assert sorted_ds.PixelData == b"\x00\x01\x01\x02\x02\x03\x03\x04"


def test_encapsulated_pixel_data_is_rebuilt_without_extended_offsets():
    ds = make_dataset(encapsulated=True)
    out = extract_frames(ds, [2, 0])
    assert list(generate_frames(out.PixelData, number_of_frames=2)) == [b"\x02\x03", b"\x00\x01"]
    assert "ExtendedOffsetTable" not in out
    assert "ExtendedOffsetTableLengths" not in out
